fixtures.intent: Small lateral steps (0.15 m per sampling interval) along a Trevi-like façade 6 m away with 0.45 m relief. Relief parallax is 0.63 px per interval, below the 1.25 px rotation-only gate, and 10.7 px over the clip. Cameras should register.

expected_failures.reason: No adjacent pair passes the residual-parallax gate, so no seed pair is accepted.
No camera pose exists to score.

fixtures.intent: The same façade and viewing direction with the camera rotating in place by the pan's image motion. Negative control: the translation-baseline gate must reject it and no camera may register.

A pan (0.2 m per interval) over a façade 4 m away with 1 m relief on gentle slopes; adjacent views overlap by more than 90 %, so neighbouring reference patches see the same surface. The truth is one connected surface, so overlapping patches must share topology.

expected_failures.reason: Each reference patch is triangulated on its own; no triangle spans two reference patches, so overlapping patches stay separate sheets.

baseline.notes: The true surface is one component; the accepted mesh has 59. Every one of them lies inside a single reference patch (per_patch_components equals mesh_components): dense coverage holes and discontinuity rejections fragment each patch, and no patch connects to another. Only the cross-patch part is gated here (#126); component counts are reported against the truth.
